_how_to_edit: Put a member's name in "name" (and optionally "major" and "year"). Leave name empty to show the role as Open. Sector teams use the GICS sector names. Then reload the Team page.

leadership.duty: Runs the portfolio day to day, sizes positions within policy limits and executes approved trades.
Chairs the investment committee and sets the research agenda across sector teams.
Monitors concentration, beta, drawdowns and policy compliance, independent of the pitching teams.
Edits every report for quality and consistency and maintains the pitch pipeline.
Keeps the trade ledger, data job and website accurate, and runs recruiting.
Advises the fund, approves the investment policy and attends committee meetings.
